Banana Oat Pancakes

Soft weekend pancakes with mashed banana in the batter and strawberries folded through. Make a double batch: they reheat well in a toaster.

  • Ripe bananas give the most sweetness.
  • Frozen berries work too.

Banana Oat Pancakes

Ingredients

  • 1¼ cups bread flour
  • 3 tablespoons granulated sugar
  • 1 teaspoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon ground ginger
  • ½ teaspoon nutmeg
  • Heaping ¼ teaspoon fine salt
  • 1 large egg
  • ¾ cup plus 2 tablespoons oat milk
  • ⅓ cup mashed ripe banana
  • 2 tablespoons sunflower oil or melted butter, plus more for the pan
  • 1 teaspoon almond extract
  • 1½ cups sliced strawberries, fresh or frozen*
  • Honey, for drizzling

Instructions

  • Stir the flour, sugar, baking powder, ginger, nutmeg and salt together in a wide bowl.
  • Beat the egg with the oat milk, banana, oil and almond extract, then fold it into the dry mix with half of the strawberries.
  • Cook spoonfuls on an oiled pan until bubbles form, flip once and serve with the rest of the strawberries and a drizzle of honey.
Egg-free:
Swap the egg for 1 tablespoon ground chia seeds soaked in 3 tablespoons water for 10 minutes.
